 Published Nov. 15, 2026 4:43 a.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Associated Press Texas Longhorns (3-0) vs. Baylor Bears (3-0)
 San Antonio; Sunday, 3 p.m. EST
 BOTTOM LINE: Baylor plays No. 7 Texas in San Antonio, Texas.
 Baylor finished 17-17 overall with an 11-4 record against non-conference opponents in the 2025-26 season. The Bears averaged 13.1 points off of turnovers, 13.5 second-chance points and 15.0 bench points last season.
 Texas went 21-15 overall with a 12-5 record against non-conference opponents during the 2025-26 season. The Longhorns gave up 76.2 points per game while committing 18.8 fouls last season.
